data.text: Built 9 REST and GraphQL APIs serving 40k daily requests at p95 under 120 ms
Cut a reporting query from 14 s to 600 ms with partial indexes and a materialized view in PostgreSQL
Moved order events onto Kafka, removing 3 polling jobs and a nightly batch
Wrote the CI pipeline (GitHub Actions, Docker) that runs 1,100 tests in 6 minutes
Led the on-call rotation for 4 services; wrote the runbooks that halved time to mitigate
Built a retrieval pipeline over 60k support articles with pgvector; answer acceptance rose 22%
Wrote an LLM evaluation harness (240 graded cases) that gates every prompt change in CI
Built a tool-calling agent that drafts refunds for human approval, with every action logged
Exposed an internal search API as an MCP server used by 3 teams' AI clients
Shipped a React + TypeScript dashboard used by 300 support agents every day
Raised the app's Lighthouse accessibility score from 71 to 98
Rebuilt the marketing site in Next.js with ISR; time to first byte fell from 900 ms to 140 ms
Wrote Airflow DAGs that load 2 TB a day from 14 sources into the warehouse with data contracts
Modeled 80 dbt tables with tests; broken dashboards per month went from 9 to 1
Built a streaming dedupe job (Flink) over 5M events an hour
